links.comparator_used: Direct prompting of ChatGPT-3.5 without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Generation quality (ROUGE-1-f, BERTScore_F1) in Chinese clinical question answering; expert-rated readability, accuracy and authenticity
links.effect: ROUGE-1-f +12.6%, BERTScore_F1 +1.5% (p < 0.05); expert evaluation improvements in readability, accuracy, and authenticity (all p < 0.001)
links.quote: Experimental results show that dialogue-based retrieval significantly improves generation quality relative to direct prompting (e.g., ROUGE-1-f: +12.6%, BERTScore_F1: +1.5%, p < 0.05).

links.effect: Rerank-only gave the best accuracy-latency balance among the retrieval strategies compared (no numbers given in abstract)
links.quote: Among retrieval strategies, Rerank-only provides the best accuracy-latency balance, while the cascade pipeline introduces noise and yields no additional benefit.
